unique_value: telecommand authority is cryptographically bound to the exact command digest rather than a mutable command identifier alone
authority tokens have an explicit not-before/not-after window so stale or premature command execution fails closed
successful command authority is single-use and deterministic replay is refused
fire outcomes carry deterministic receipts binding command identity, token identity, verdict, reason, and fingerprint

lineage_distinction.GlacierEQ/nasa-telemetry-anomaly-receipt: owns deterministic telemetry anomaly evidence and acknowledgement-aware alarm receipts; complementary observation plane, not command authority

capability_contribution.ownership: This repository remains the owning NASA-specialist implementation of time-bounded command authority; capability extraction preserves repository identity and lineage.

next_evolution: Add subsystem-scoped attenuating grants, explicit revocation, monotonic clock-source provenance, quorum authorization for high-risk commands, and provider/device confirmation-reconciliation while preserving exact command binding, expiry, and single-use semantics.
nonclaims: not a production spacecraft command deployment
repository relationships do not imply exercised integration
